entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""He wished to intimidate the Assemb..."
entries.dialogueText: "He wished to intimidate the Assembly against our proposal, sir. And it seems to have worked."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It doesn't matter now, does it?""
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't matter now, does it?"
entries.menuText: "It doesn't matter now, does it?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As long as he's around, he will al..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as he's around, he will always have influence over the republic which he has built. We should have seen this coming."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's just move on to our next ste..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's just move on to our next steps."
entries.menuText: "Let's just move on to our next steps."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I don't know what to say... I stil..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know what to say... I still can't believe we didn't even achieve a simple majority."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I will also try and test the water..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will also try and test the waters with our MPs. We can't let the party slip out of our grasp."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""What do we do now? All our plans,..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do we do now? All our plans, for nothing..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We'll be organizing a cabinet meet..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll be organizing a cabinet meeting to discuss our present and future state of affairs."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They both looked uncomfortable in t..."
entries.dialogueText: They both looked uncomfortable in their suits. Petr was trying not to make eye contact and kept letting out depressing sighs.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's just move on with our next s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's just move on with our next steps."
entries.menuText: "Let's just move on with our next steps."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He wiped the sweat off his forehead..."
entries.dialogueText: He wiped the sweat off his forehead with a handkerchief.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Lucian Galade: ""We'll be organizing a cabinet meet..."]

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Just try to reach out to him.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just try to reach out to him."
entries.menuText: "Just try to reach out to him."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It was all Mrs. Tory's doing...""
entries.dialogueText: "It was all Mrs. Tory's doing..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The party has finally spoken.""
entries.dialogueText: "The party has finally spoken."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Okay...""
entries.dialogueText: "Okay..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes. The USP leadership is beginni..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. The USP leadership is beginning to target us."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No, he didn't.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, he didn't."
entries.menuText: "No, he didn't."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""She changed the threshold! That bi..."
entries.dialogueText: "She changed the threshold! That bitch!"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course, sir. We must plan ahead..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, sir. We must plan ahead now."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""She merely used her authority as S..."
entries.dialogueText: "She merely used her authority as Speaker. It was a valid interpretation of the Constitution. There were more than 250 members present..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He saw their faces, but he didn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "He saw their faces, but he didn't recognize them."
entries.menuText: "He saw their faces, but he didn't recognize them."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yeah... What the hell was that all..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah... What the hell was that all about? Soll appearing out of nowhere..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes. The USP leadership is beginni..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. The USP leadership is beginning to target us as well."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Exactly. We must plan our next ste..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly. We must plan our next steps."
entries.menuText: "Exactly. We must plan our next steps."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Not to mention Tarquin Soll himsel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to mention Tarquin Soll himself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's not name any names now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not name any names now."
entries.menuText: "Let's not name any names now."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""You're right, sir. We must plan ah..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right, sir. We must plan ahead now."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Oh, he did? Who were they?""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, he did? Who were they?"

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Lucian Galade: ""We'll be organizing a cabinet meet..."]

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He came to the Assembly to make a..."
entries.dialogueText: "He came to the Assembly to make a statement. And it worked."
entries.menuText: "He came to the Assembly to make a statement. And it worked."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What's done is done. Let's not lin..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's done is done. Let's not linger in the past."
entries.menuText: "What's done is done. Let's not linger in the past."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That's too bad.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's too bad."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""In any case, I will conduct proper..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any case, I will conduct proper investigations into this. We should know every hidden Old Guard member who is working with Soll."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Gentlemen! Nothing is over yet. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gentlemen! Nothing is over yet. We still have a country to lead."
entries.menuText: "Gentlemen! Nothing is over yet. We still have a country to lead."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That wasn't your fault.""
entries.dialogueText: "That wasn't your fault."
entries.menuText: "That wasn't your fault."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""If we can lead it...""
entries.dialogueText: "If we can lead it..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Maybe you should have. Even Serge..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe you should have. Even Serge knew about it."
entries.menuText: "Maybe you should have. Even Serge knew about it."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""You're right, sir. We must plan ah..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right, sir. We must plan ahead now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should organize a cabinet meeti..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should organize a cabinet meeting to discuss the situation."
entries.menuText: "We should organize a cabinet meeting to discuss the situation."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'm sorry that we failed to gather..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry that we failed to gather the necessary intelligence about his arrival. Something went wrong on the security reports. I still don't know what. It was partly our fault."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'll do my best, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll do my best, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Y-Yes. We apologize.""
entries.dialogueText: "Y-Yes. We apologize."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He said he overheard some people t..."
entries.dialogueText: "He said he overheard some people talking about it around the Assembly."
entries.menuText: "He said he overheard some people talking about it around the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's all good.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's all good."
entries.menuText: "It's all good."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""In a situation such as this, I wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "In a situation such as this, I would have expected Karl to report it to me. But it's no excuse. We should have done our own research."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I learned it from Serge. How come..."
entries.dialogueText: "I learned it from Serge. How come MY DRIVER knows more than YOU!?"
entries.menuText: "I learned it from Serge. How come MY DRIVER knows more than YOU!?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What's done is done. Let's not lin..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's done is done. Let's not linger in the past."
entries.menuText: "What's done is done. Let's not linger in the past."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, he did.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, he did."
entries.menuText: "Yes, he did."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""In a situation such as this, I wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "In a situation such as this, I would have expected Karl to report it to me. But you're right, sir. We should have done our own research."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But he has no authority anymore.""
entries.dialogueText: "But he has no authority anymore."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I just still can't believe I didn'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just still can't believe I didn't know about this beforehand."
entries.menuText: "I just still can't believe I didn't know about this beforehand."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Well, the laws protect him from al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, the laws protect him from almost anything, and allows him to be a member of the Assembly. He can still propose bills and vote for them."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course not, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course not, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That's proper authority, if you as..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's proper authority, if you ask me. When you are the founder of this system, you don't need to be sitting in the presidential office to have power."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I hope you are not hiding anything..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you are not hiding anything from me."
entries.menuText: "I hope you are not hiding anything from me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you saying he still has more a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you saying he still has more authority than me?"
entries.menuText: "Are you saying he still has more authority than me?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lucian's right. He already showcas..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucian's right. He already showcased his powers at the vote. We must be careful."
entries.menuText: "Lucian's right. He already showcased his powers at the vote. We must be careful."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""What? Me? Never!""
entries.dialogueText: "What? Me? Never!"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The party is in disarray since we..."
entries.dialogueText: "The party is in disarray since we lost the vote. Soll might be working behind the scenes against us."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""He didn't see who they were, did h..."
entries.dialogueText: "He didn't see who they were, did he?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I want to talk to him. Do you know..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to talk to him. Do you know if he's still in Holsord?"
entries.menuText: "I want to talk to him. Do you know if he's still in Holsord?"

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Lucian Galade: ""We'll be organizing a cabinet meet..."]

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""No, sir. But he certainly has enor..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, sir. But he certainly has enormous influence."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It seems some of our respected MPs..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems some of our respected MPs already knew about this."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We must be careful, indeed. The pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must be careful, indeed. The party is in disarray since we lost the vote."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""...Which we will. You're right, si..."
entries.dialogueText: "...Which we will. You're right, sir. We must plan ahead now."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""And with Soll making a comeback......"
entries.dialogueText: "And with Soll making a comeback... We cannot trust anyone in the USP to keep supporting us."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I guess not.""
entries.dialogueText: "I guess not."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""He must be, sir. But he didn't eve..."
entries.dialogueText: "He must be, sir. But he didn't even come to the Palace to pay his respects. I don't know what to expect."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We cannot let the party turn again..."
entries.dialogueText: "We cannot let the party turn against the administration."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""It smells fishy.""
entries.dialogueText: "It smells fishy."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course, sir. I'll make the nece..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, sir. I'll make the necessary arrangements."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I want a list of every party membe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want a list of every party member who voted against the proposal."
entries.menuText: "I want a list of every party member who voted against the proposal."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good. I want each minister to give..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. I want each minister to give me a report."
entries.menuText: "Good. I want each minister to give me a report."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The party has to learn to respect..."
entries.dialogueText: "The party has to learn to respect me. Tarquin Soll is not their leader anymore."
entries.menuText: "The party has to learn to respect me. Tarquin Soll is not their leader anymore."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Sir, it was a secret ballot.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sir, it was a secret ballot."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't care. I want names.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't care. I want names."
entries.menuText: "I don't care. I want names."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Goddammit.""
entries.dialogueText: "Goddammit."
entries.menuText: "Goddammit."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course, sir. I'll do what I can.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, sir. I'll do what I can."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Don't worry, sir. We'll address th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry, sir. We'll address the party soon enough, and put them in their proper place."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, sir."
